My friend and I rented the Galaxy Hotel for two nights. When I got there, they told us that we don't have any room right now. We'll take you to one of our other hotels. When we got there, it was really awful. We said that this wasn't the right place for us. They said it is what it is I actually confused.
This is compliment  for manager of the galaxy hotel.
Good luck.

We visited for my grand nephew s birthday party. My daughter felt unwell after eating the oily starters and ended up vomiting in the hallway as weleft. They created a big scene and I had to negotiate to get it cleaned up at a reasonable price. Sad guests are treated this way .

We hosted our wedding in Tulip clubhouse and booked 64 rooms in RR galaxy to accommodate our guests.

Only pro is the location of this hotel in case you are hosting wedding/event in Tulip clubhouse.

Here are the cons -
- Room service is really bad
- Bathrooms are clogged
- They don’t clean rooms if you are staying for longer duration
- They charge for everything, even complimentary water
